references.text: God's command to Moses that the Israelites should give the Levites cities and pasturelands from their inheritance, as Joshua 21:8 refers to this as fulfillment.
The Lord spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab that the Levites should receive cities to live in.
Lots were used to distribute the inheritance, as is also mentioned here regarding the Levitical cities.
The Levites asked for cities with pasturelands according to the Lord's command through Moses, which is fulfilled here.
Summary of the total forty-eight Levitical cities with pasturelands that were given to the Levites.
Parallel account of the Levitical cities that were given to the different Levite families.
The laws concerning the Levites' cities and their pasturelands, which could not be sold, because they were their permanent possession.
